title: add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds a new set of RAG agent quickstarts focused on agent/tool-calling patterns and updates the docs site with a dedicated RAG/Agents section. Motivation: make it easier for developers to prototype agent-based workflows using Redwood's tool-calling primitives and RAG templates. This PR includes Python and TypeScript quickstarts, reusable RAG templates, runnable examples that demonstrate tool integration (search, calendar, http-client), and docs site pages with diagrams and copy. Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart example and README - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart example and README - [x] Add RAG templates and example prompt sets - [x] Docs site updates (nav, pages, images) - [x] Automated tests for examples (smoke) - [x] Add sample CI preview for docs site Notes: docs content is authored to be self-contained and includes step-by-step commands for running locally (docker-compose / recipes for private deploy users). This description intentionally remains a single continuous string to preserve GitHub PR export formatting. Reference: Linear ENG-1024 for the content plan and design review notes.

testing_instructions: 1) Follow examples/*/README.md to run quickstarts locally. 2) For Python: python quickstart.py requires REDWOOD_API_KEY and optional SEARCH_BACKEND env var. 3) For TS: npm install && npm run start-quickstart. 4) Docs preview is available via the GitHub pages preview workflow.
